answer: The terrace of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Each submission hangs on the haven of a task receipt, and the pearl is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
